# GitHub Actions：矩阵 + 缓存 + artifact + fail-fast（说明型示例，本机无仓库无法实跑）
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

env:
  CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE: 1

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      # 一个矩阵单元失败不要立刻取消其它单元，便于一次看全所有平台的结果
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        std: [17, 20]
        build_type: [Debug, Release]
        exclude:
          # 只在 Linux 上跑 C++20，节省 CI 分钟数
          - os: windows-latest
          - os: macos-latest
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            std: 20
            sanitizer: address,undefined
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 缓存依赖（第三方源码与 ccache）
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/ccache
            build/_deps
          key: ${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.std }}-deps-${{ hashFiles('CMakeLists.txt') }}

      - name: 配置
        run: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }} -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=${{ matrix.std }}

      - name: 构建
        run: cmake --build build --config ${{ matrix.build_type }} -j

      - name: 测试
        run: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure -C ${{ matrix.build_type }}

      - name: 上传测试报告（无论成败都要）
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-report-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.std }}
          path: build/Testing/

  deploy:
    needs: [build-and-test]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo release
